To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have proposed a general framework for image parsing, which is a unified framework for image segmentation, detection and recognition.

(1) the proposed framework is a unified framework for parsing images, (2) the proposed framework combines bottom-up and top down generative models, (3) the proposed framework performs segmentation, object detection and recognition simultaneously, (4) the proposed framework uses a probabilistic version AdaBoost to learn the proposals for text and face detection, (5) the proposed framework makes use of the data driven MCMC algorithm for inference.
we propose a general framework that unifies segmentation, detection, recognition, and parsing in natural scenes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How do we parse an image into regions and objects in a unified framework?
the development of a general image parsing framework, which is applicable to any image domain.
developing new models and algorithms for the joint problem of segmentation, detection and recognition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method is a significant advance in image parsing, which has been a long standing problem in computer vision.
this paper proposes a general framework for image parsing.
we have developed a new approach to object recognition in natural images, which combines segmentation, detection, classification and recognition in a principled way.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to detect, localize, and recognize text and faces with high accuracy and robustness, even in the presence of clutter, occlusion, and complex background.
we propose a unified approach to image parsing that combines segmentation, detection and recognition.
we have shown that it is possible to parse images into regions and object by combining generative models with bottom-up proposals.
The main takeaway from our work is that
image parsing is a unified task that involves simultaneously performing image segmentation and object detection and recognition.
the segmentation of an image into regions can be used as an intermediate representation for object detection/recognition.
we have shown that a unified approach for image parsing is possible and can be made to work.
